work.title: Make architecture and artifact checks required
work.description: Ensure the existing CI matrix and artifact validation are required before integration into main: typecheck, unit and integration tests, smoke, architecture tests, and published tarball validation become required checks; direct pushes to main are disabled for normal development; squash merge is the default integration method; the repository documents emergency bypass authority; manifest projection commits are not exempt from CI while they still exist.
acceptance: A PR cannot merge while a required check is failing
Direct pushes to main are disabled for normal development
Squash merge is the default integration method
The repository documents emergency bypass authority
Manifest projection commits are not exempt from CI while they still exist
